messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

For generations, our foundry has taken great pride in supplying our regional partners with the utmost care and quality. To continue serving you with the craftsmanship you expect from us, we must account for our rising expenses. Over the past twelve months, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost.

Taking these developments into consideration, we are pleased to present our offer for a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We value our long-standing relationship deeply and look forward to continuing our successful cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Dear colleagues at Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG,

Thank you for your letter and for setting out your position.

By the figures you gave us - LCI-C +2.7% at 30% of your cost, PPI-C241 +6.5% at 24% of your cost - the weighted effect on the price is about +2.4%, not the 9.5% you ask for. Your letter gives us only 51 days of notice (doc:20260911-70110-P01, ctr:4600070110). Our contract requires 90 days. The German labour cost index for manufacturing changed +2.7% from 2025-06 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06, idx:LCI-C@2026-06).

The data does not support your price as it stands; the options below follow from it.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 133.52 per unit, payment 90 days net, new price from 2026-11-01.
Option B: EUR 131.77 per unit, payment 30 days net, new price from 2026-11-01.
Option C: EUR 132.20 per unit, payment 45 days net, new price from 2026-11-01.

Could you share a cost breakdown for this part - material, conversion, overhead?

We are happy to go through the figures together.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose. We checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. We acknowledge your points regarding the notice period and the indices, though the weighted effect does not capture all our operational realities. 

Please understand that as a privately held family foundry, we do not disclose internal cost breakdowns. Our costs move with LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351; the figures stay with us.

In exchange for maintaining the 1 November 2026 effective date and 30-day payment terms, we are prepared to reduce our price to EUR 135.90 per unit. For our offer, we state a price of €135.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer is valid for 30 days.

We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Dear colleagues at Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG,

Thank you for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you.

Your on-time delivery over the last four quarters was 85.2% (sc:70110@2026Q3). German producer prices for electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).

We would rather spend our time making good pumps together than exchanging e-mails about cents, so we have tried to make the options below easy to say yes to.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 134.91 per unit, payment 90 days net, new price from 2026-11-01.
Option B: EUR 133.13 per unit, payment 30 days net, new price from 2026-11-01.
Option C: EUR 133.57 per unit, payment 45 days net, new price from 2026-11-01.

Which cost elements of this part have actually risen since our last price agreement?

We look forward to your reply and to many more years of good cooperation.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,
Thank you for your letter - it is always good to hear from you, and I answer it myself, as I do for all the customers we have known for a long time.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €133.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 November 2026.
A few words from the foundry on this.
We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We did not know that - a fair point.
LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. That remains.
PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. That remains.
As a family business, we keep our detailed cost breakdowns internal, but we assure you that labor and specific material costs have increased.
Building on your 30-day payment option, we can offer a revised price of €133.50 per unit.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
Our Lieferzeit is 42 days.
Please give my regards to your colleagues - a good relationship has always mattered more to us than a single order, and I hope it stays that way.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
